_doc: References for entities that carry a look but not an identity: places and crowds. The studio has always conditioned a shot on the SHEETS of the people in it. A hall and a body of ministers have no face to lock and no model sheet, and until now that meant they contributed nothing to a generation and - for the crowd - blocked the gate outright.
_rule: These are NOT sheets and never become them. The consistency gate binds on PEOPLE and must keep binding only on people; nothing here clears a principal or stands in for one. A reference here changes how a shot is DRAWN, never who is allowed in it.
_source: references/court/README.md, chosen by the user on 2026-09-22 from OpenAI candidates.

SABHA.why: one hall across seven films. Lattice windows on the LEFT wall only - the key light is frame-left, and a candidate with windows on both walls was rejected for it.
SABHA.carries: the throne dais, the sun disc, the chamara attendants, the guards

COURT.why: a crowd cannot have a model sheet. These two plates are the court, and no minister needs one of his own.
rules: All upper cloth draped. Two candidates were rejected for stitched tunics and vests - never let one back in.
Leave out the forearm tattoo on one minister in court_row_left.png - it reads modern.
Vasistha comes from his own sheet. Among the ministers he is the only one in plain white with no gold.
If a single minister is ever seen close, condition that shot on one chosen face from the row plates, so he stays the same man if seen again.
